problem: A newly merged, authorized frozen-file thaw can appear on unrelated descendant work while the separate frozen-registry branch still pins the old blob, causing stale verification and cascading false-red DevSystem failures.
root_cause: Frozen verification currently runs before a dedicated state barrier distinguishes exact candidate thaws, newly merged inherited thaws awaiting registry forward-port, and genuinely unauthorized drift.
patch: Add a read-only reconciliation barrier that classifies aligned/exact-candidate states as READY, newly merged inherited thaw mismatches as REGISTRY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED WAIT, and unmatched drift as a hard block. The barrier does not mutate Git or the registry.
